reproducibility_gaps: The active training loop clears gradients immediately before optimizer.step and never calls GradScaler.step/update, blocking a valid training reproduction without repair.
The evaluation loop names its metrics container RRDB while loading SPSR weights and writing SPSR output paths.
IXI volumes and pretrained weights are external, were not access-validated, and have no repository-pinned checksums.
Training and inference contain user-specific absolute paths, unconditional CUDA calls and an uncreated Models output directory.
README activation names s2l8h while environment.yml declares srmri and exports a user-specific prefix.
No repository license defines reuse terms.
notes: R2 is supported by pinned source, a detailed versioned environment and installation commands. R3 is blocked by unavailable external inputs and consequential training/evaluation defects.
